card.name: Dose units just before /m2
card.fires_on: The unit word mg (or the g in mcg) right after a number when the next piece is /m 2, meaning dose per body surface area. It appears in dosing tables and animal-to-human dose comparisons.

modes.label: mg before /m2
modes.description: The unit mg after a dose number, directly followed by /m 2 for body surface area.

modes.label: Bare unit in parentheses
modes.description: The unit mg opening a parenthesis that states the basis as mg/m 2.
modes.example: on a body surface area (<<mg>>/m 2 ) basis.

card.writes: It suppresses tokens that begin with m, which fits a slash and m being expected next.
card.plain: It marks the dose unit when a per-body-surface-area dose such as mg/m2 is about to be written.
